chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Marge's piano lessons, ragtime and East St. Louis
summary: Marge studied piano for three years by the Czerny method and learned ragtime from Frank Eubanks, who learned it from Jelly Roll Morton. They clarify that East St. Louis is across the bridge in Illinois.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What I wanted to ask you though was what was your music background, I mean what -- how had you -- I mean had you been trained as a pianist?

Yes, I had taken lessons, and I wanted to play rag time but I took lessons from a piano teacher who was teaching my sister, and my sister didn't have any talent for piano. I could play her exercises just by listening to them in the other room. So I had all the talent, and I took lessons for oh, about three years, and -- the Czerny method they called it.
Which everybody now -- the piano players now tell me what a good method that was.

I played house parties and all of that, just for my own pleasure and then I would learn rag time piano from Frank Eubanks, who learned it from Jelly Roll, and then he would teach me these rags, you know, and I would play house parties --
Jelly Roll had spent quite a bit of time in --
He was playing in a nickelodeon there when I was going to high school.
Well, now what is the difference between East St. Louis and St. Louis. Is that --
It's a bridge, East St. Louis is across the East Bridge.
And East St. Louis is in Illinois.
Illinois, and St. Louis is in Missouri.
It's just right across the bridge.
